summary: Backend (9 pytest tests, 8 passed) and full UI E2E (signup, nav, add private/shared habit, 7-day ticks, streak, reload persistence, sign out, Bob signin, community, read-only for non-owner, comments, wrong-password error) tested. Every requested feature works. One issue: the brute-force lockout does not trigger reliably behind the ingress.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is unreliable. The identifier uses request.client.host, which is the rotating ingress pod IP (seen 10.81.4.212 and 10.81.4.213 for the same client). Failed attempts get split across keys (count 4 + 2), so the 6th bad attempt returned 401 instead of 429.

issues: Sidebar has 'hidden md:flex', so the sidebar buttons are missing on mobile. The top nav links are still there. Not verified in a browser at mobile size.

action_items: Signin lockout: build the identifier from the first IP in the X-Forwarded-For header (fall back to request.client.host), or key the lockout on email only, so attempts count consistently behind the ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: lockout identifier uses the proxy IP (see above).
MyHabits/Community/Comments GET calls have no .catch, so a failure leaves the page on 'loading' with no error state.
habit_out runs N+1 queries (ticks plus owner per habit). Fine at this scale.
test_credentials: alice@example.com/alice123, bob@example.com/bob12345 both work. bcrypt hashes start with $2b$. Auth is Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (by design). No admin/seed in this app.
seed_data_creation: Created test_*@example.com / ui_*@example.com users with TEST_ habits and a Bob comment on 'TEST Shared Walk'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_habit_circle.py. test_lockout fails until the ingress IP issue is fixed. Browser dates are in UTC in playwright.
rca of the issue: Lockout: ident = f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Requests pass through several ingress pods with different IPs, so login_attempts holds several docs for one email (e.g. 10.81.4.212:x count 4, 10.81.4.213:x count 2), none of which reaches 5. Fix: use the X-Forwarded-For header (first IP) or key on email only.
